card.name: Unit abbreviations after a number
card.fires_on: Short unit abbreviations right after a number, such as kph, bpm, kg, mph, dpi, lb and KB. Often the unit completes a spelled-out measure like beats per minute.

modes.label: Rate abbreviations
modes.description: Abbreviated rates like bpm, kph, mph and dpi, often in parentheses after the spelled-out form.
modes.example: heart rates of 60 beats per minute (b<<pm>>) or greater treated with lanreotide

modes.label: Weight and size units
modes.description: Units such as kg, lb and KB directly after a number.

card.writes: It suppresses spelled-out measure words like miles, grams, seconds and volts, so the abbreviated unit is not followed by a full unit word.
card.plain: It marks the short unit tag after a number, such as bpm or kg, where a full unit word is no longer expected.
